images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Front of a barn on Brush Creek Road at the Glencoe Road intersection in Northampton Township, Somerset County, Pennsylvania, United States.

brief: Concrete stave silo about 18 ft across and 50 ft high standing against the end of a white gambrel dairy barn, its grey staves and hoops almost entirely overgrown by climbing Virginia creeper turning red and bronze, capped by a shiny galvanized steel dome. A square enclosed chute column of white metal runs up the side next to the barn. Mown grass at its foot and a small stone gatepost wall nearby.

facade.notes: Ponfeigh Farm (Northampton Twp PA, c.1940): a white gambrel dairy barn with the farm name painted in the gable, a red-brick ground storey with glass-block windows (the milking parlour), and two ivy-covered concrete stave silos with a metal dome against its end; a stone gate pier

why.note: the dairy farm's silo: concrete staves from c.1910, built against the barn's end so silage could be pitched down a chute into the feeding alley
the gambrel roof gives a big clear hay loft over a masonry dairy floor
